known_issues: PDF generation fails for all products with error: "Failed to generate PDF for 'Digital Planner Mastery' (Product 1). Please verify that the product name, subtitle, and description are filled in and try again."

existing_features.title: Improve PDF-step error handling so the UI shows an accurate, actionable message based on the real underlying PDF error (e.g., missing jsPDF CDN library vs. missing/invalid product fields), instead of always prompting to verify name/subtitle/description.
Add pre-validation before attempting PDF generation for each product to ensure required fields are present and non-empty (after trimming), and prevent generation when validation fails.

Harden the PDF generator against undefined/empty text inputs by safely normalizing product fields to strings and guarding jsPDF text calls so generation does not crash due to unexpected undefined/null values coming from drafts or merges.
